items.q: What does an element's group number tell you?
items.correct: The number of electrons in its outer shell.
items.misconception: The number of electron shells it has.
items.why: Group number = outer-shell electrons; period number = number of occupied shells.

items.q: Why are the Group 0 noble gases unreactive?
items.correct: They have full outer electron shells.
items.misconception: They are very reactive and readily bond.
items.why: A full outer shell makes noble gases stable and very unreactive.

items.q: How does reactivity change down Group 1 (alkali metals)?
items.why: Group 1 reactivity increases down the group; Group 7 (halogens) reactivity decreases down the group.
